releaseNotes:
The calorie ring is an object again. After dark its edge catches the light instead of reading as a hole in the screen, and the part you haven't eaten yet shows what is left of the day rather than a plain grey band. The home-screen widget too.

And the three of them make the whole journey now: up while your entry is read, then down onto the card — instead of turning up already sitting on it.
